topIssues.title: [L2CM] Add ProxyAdminOwnedBase access control to predeploy initialize() functions
topIssues.author: aliersh
topIssues.body:
**FMA follow-up (FM1):** As identified in the [L2CM FMA](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/design-docs/blob/main/security/fma-l2cm.md), the L2CM upgrade mechanism clears the `initialized` slot and re-calls `initialize()` on predeploy proxies. If `initialize()` is open to anyone post-upgrade, an attacker could front-run or re-initialize with malicious parameters.

All predeploy contracts that have an `initialize()` function should use [`ProxyAdminOwnedBase._assertOnlyProxyAdminOrProxyAdminOwner()`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/develop/packages/contracts-bedrock/src/L1/ProxyAdminOwnedBase.sol#L101) to restrict who can call `initialize()`.

### Acceptance Criteria

- All proxied L2 predeploy `initialize()` functions are protected with `ProxyAdminOwnedBase` access control
- Tests verify that `initialize()` reverts when called by unauthorized addresses

### References

- [L2CM FMA — FM1: Re-initialization State Corruption](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/design-docs/blob/main/security/fma-l2cm.md)

topPRs.title: docs: add Actions SDK swap documentation
topPRs.author: jefr90
topPRs.body: ## Summary This PR fills in the missing swap documentation for the Actions SDK and fixes a few infrastructure gaps that were preventing the doc generation pipeline from working correctly. ### What's new - **`swap-documentation.mdx`** — the swap reference page was already wired into the `docs.json` nav but the file itself was never created. This adds it, documenting `wallet.swap` operations: `execute()`, `getQuote()`, `getQuotes()`, `getMarket()`, `getMarkets()`, and `supportedChainIds()`. ### Infrastructure fixes found along the way - **`generate-sdk-components.ts` (new file)** — the shared TypeScript doc generation utility was never committed to any repo (not `ethereum-optimism/docs`, not `ethereum-optimism/optimism`, not `ethereum-optimism/actions`). It was always a local-only file, making the `prebuild` script broken for anyone other than the original author. This PR adds it so the pipeline is fully reproducible. - **`WalletSwapNamespace` added to `generate-actions-components.ts`** — the old `ethereum-optimism/docs` repo already had this entry; it was dropped when the docs were migrated to the monorepo. - **`swap-documentation` added to `docs.json` nav** — the page reference was missing from the sidebar navigation, so the page would have been unreachable even after being created. - **`--local` SDK path fixed** — `LOCAL_SDK_PATH` in `generate-actions-components.ts` was computing the wrong path for the monorepo directory structure (it was written for the old standalone docs repo where `actions/` was one level up; in the monorepo it's three levels up). - **`@eth-optimism/actions-sdk` bumped `0.1.0` → `0.4.0`** — the installed version did not include swap source files. `0.4.0` does, making the non-local prebuild work end-to-end. - **Node version bumped to `20.17.0`** in both `.nvmrc` and `.npmrc` — `@mintlify/cli` requires Node ≥ 20.17. ### Related - [ethereum-optimism/actions#367](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/actions/issues/367) — follow-up to add missing `@param` JSDoc to `WalletSwapNamespace.getQuote()` and `getQuotes()` overrides, which currently show empty parameter descriptions in the generated docs. ## Test plan - [ ] `pnpm prebuild` in `docs/public-docs/` — all four snippets generate without errors - [ ] `pnpm prebuild:local` — works with the corrected local SDK path (requires `actions` repo checked out as a sibling) - [ ] `/app-developers/reference/actions/swap-documentation` renders with full method table - [ ] Swap page appears in the sidebar under **Actions SDK** - [ ] Existing lend/wallet reference pages unaffected ## Screenshots

topPRs.title: feat(op-reth): activate EIP-7823 modexp upper bounds on Karst fork
topPRs.author: joshklop
topPRs.body:
Wire up the Karst OP fork through the Rust EL stack so that EIP-7823 (modexp precompile input upper bounds of 1024 bytes) takes effect when Karst activates. Karst remains at SpecId::PRAGUE to avoid unsupported fork errors in reth v2.0.0; the modexp limit is enforced via a custom karst() precompile set that swaps modexp::BERLIN for modexp::OSAKA.

Changes:
- Add OpSpecId::KARST variant mapped to SpecId::PRAGUE
- Add karst() precompile set with modexp::OSAKA (EIP-7823 limits)
- Add karst_time to OpGenesisInfo, HardforkConfig, ChainConfigExtraFields
- Wire is_karst_active_at_timestamp into spec_by_timestamp_after_bedrock
- Register OpHardfork::Karst in chainspec From<Genesis>, DEV_HARDFORKS, devnet config, and OpChainSpecBuilder
- Add KarstTime to Go RollupConfig() output (was missing)
- Add acceptance test TestEIP7823UpperBoundModExp verifying pre/post fork behavior

Stacked on #20067 

---
For reference https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/design-docs/blob/main/protocol/fusaka-on-l2.md
